description: NaH₁₂Te(CO)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅31c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CH₃O tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CH₃O tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. C is bonded to three H and one O atom to form CH₃O tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-71°. All C-H bond lengths are 1.10 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.44 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Te and one O atom. The H-Te bond length is 2.50 Å. The H-O bond length is 1.01 Å. Te is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent H and one Te atom. The Te-Te bond length is 2.79 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one C, and one H atom.
